top_comments.author: heyagent
top_comments.body: This is really impacting our workflows.. The prompts for managing the plan still need to show, but we don't need anything else when we are running in dangerously skip permissions mode.

top_comments.author: wojo
top_comments.body: This is now possible, not sure when, but v1.0.31 allows you to shift-tab between "Bypassing Permissions" and then the other 3 modes (normal, plan and auto-accept edits).

top_comments.author: rboyce-ant
top_comments.body: @shivanathd @heyagent This should be available and working correctly now – you can switch modes with Shift+Tab when launching in Bypass Permissions mode
